en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a European town seen from an elevated, tree-framed vantage point. In the foreground are detached houses with steep tiled roofs. In the middle and background stand denser town buildings and a large church or civic building with a tall, pointed spire dominating the skyline. The scene is printed in an old photographic style typical of early 20th-century postcards. In the upper right corner the caption 'Löbau i. Sa.' is printed in a decorative script.
